result.reason: The operative language does not guarantee Corio a 30-day convenience right because Commerce One may unilaterally extend the notice period to 60 days. Although 60 days is within the customer fallback and the refund language appropriately covers prepaid post-termination fees, the clause leaves Commerce One's existing end-of-term termination/nonrenewal right at only 30 days' notice, rather than the fallback-required 90 days. The vendor-election construct is also an unnecessary and awkward concession, and the margin comment inaccurately characterizes the clause as providing a 30-day right. Unrelated breach and insolvency rights are preserved.
